privacyData.title: Privacy notice
privacyData.description: How Bursara handles account, institution and student financial information.
sections: Contact
Bursara is a product of Streak Technologies Ltd, Royal Road, Pointe aux Cannoniers, Grand Bay, Mauritius. Contact support@streaktechnologies.com or +230 215 2998 about the application or its data.
Demonstration data

The shared demonstration institution contains fictional records and is accessible to other testers. Use fictional names, contacts and financial entries there. Do not enter personal student information, real payments or confidential documents into the shared demonstration.
Information processed

The application stores institution settings, user login details, permissions, student and debtor records, courses, drafts, invoices, receipts, allocations and financial corrections. Personal sign-in settings may include passkey records, encrypted authenticator secrets and encrypted recovery codes.
Support access sessions record the staff user, institution and entry and exit times. Hosting and application logs may include IP addresses, request times and errors for troubleshooting.
Cookies and hosting

Essential cookies keep you signed in, protect forms and remember your language choice. The product website is hosted on Cloudflare Pages; the application runs on a separate Debian server. Bursara installs no advertising trackers.
Optional fiscal module

The Mauritius EBS module is disabled for the shared demonstration. When configured in a separate institution, an explicit test submission sends the prepared fiscal document to EBS Mauritius. API credentials are encrypted in the database and omitted from browser responses.
Access and removal
Contact support to discuss access to, correction of or removal of your account and data, and the applicable data-handling arrangements. Shared demonstration records may be reset.

termsData.title: Terms of use
termsData.description: Using Bursara, its shared demonstration and optional fiscal module.
sections: The service

Bursara is supplied by Streak Technologies Ltd for student invoicing, receipting and financial administration. Features and service arrangements should be agreed with your institution before relying on them for its operations.
Shared demonstration

Use fictional data and simulated transactions in the shared demonstration. Other testers can see those records, and demonstration data may be reset. Demonstration documents are not real payment acknowledgements or tax invoices.
Documents and fiscal reporting

Your institution is responsible for correct charges, payment records, tax treatment and authorised posting. The optional Mauritius integration currently targets the EBS test environment. Live fiscal reporting, fiscal correction workflows and additional country modules require separate validation.
Access and responsibility

Keep private institution and platform staff credentials confidential. Use support access only for authorised assistance. Do not try to access another institution’s records or disrupt the service. Keep personal verification and recovery codes private.
Feedback and support

Report defects with the screen, the steps taken and the expected outcome. Remove confidential information from examples. Contact support@streaktechnologies.com or +230 215 2998. Visit streaktechnologies.com for company information.
